title: Hush, it's Sunday: why Germans happily let their shops stay shut

words.note: 感叹词：Hush, the baby's sleeping.（嘘，宝宝在睡觉。）名词 a hush fell over the room（屋里一下安静下来）。
words.ctx: Hush, it's Sunday: why Germans happily let their shops stay shut

ex.en: [[Hush]], you'll wake the baby!
ex.zh: 嘘，你会吵醒宝宝的！

ex.en: A [[hush]] fell over the crowd.
ex.zh: 人群一下子安静下来。

words.def: used to tell someone to be quiet; a period of silence

cloze.after: , it's Sunday: why Germans happily let their shops stay shut
cloze.szh: 嘘，今天是星期天：德国人为什么乐意让商店关门

words.note: 形容词 efficient（高效的）。energy efficiency（能源效率）。
words.ctx: In a country famous for efficiency, one day a week is set aside for doing almost nothing at all.

ex.en: The new system has improved [[efficiency]].
ex.zh: 新系统提高了效率。

ex.en: She works with great [[efficiency]].
ex.zh: 她工作效率很高。

words.def: the quality of doing something well without wasting time, money or energy

cf.diff: efficiency 是“效率高、不浪费”（又快又省）；effectiveness 是“有效果、达到目的”，不管花了多少成本。形容词 efficient / effective 同理。

ex.en: The new drug is very [[effective]].
ex.zh: 这种新药很有效。

cloze.before: In a country famous for
cloze.after: , one day a week is set aside for doing almost nothing at all.
cloze.szh: 在一个以效率著称的国家，每周有一天专门留出来，几乎什么都不做。

words.note: set aside time / money for sth：为……留出时间 / 钱。过去式和过去分词都是 set。
words.ctx: In a country famous for efficiency, one day a week is set aside for doing almost nothing at all.

ex.en: I [[set aside]] an hour a day for reading.
ex.zh: 我每天留出一小时读书。

ex.en: They [[set aside]] money for the holiday.
ex.zh: 他们为度假存了一笔钱。

words.def: to keep something, such as time or money, for a particular purpose

cloze.before: In a country famous for efficiency, one day a week is set
cloze.after: for doing almost nothing at all.
cloze.szh: 在一个以效率著称的国家，每周有一天专门留出来，几乎什么都不做。

words.expr: would not have it any other way
words.zh: 就喜欢这样、不想要别的样子
words.core: would not have it any other way
forms: would not have it any other way
wouldn't have it any other way
words.note: 表示对现状很满意，哪怕它有缺点：It's hard work, but I wouldn't have it any other way.
m: would not have it any other way
words.ctx: Newcomers grumble; most Germans would not have it any other way.

ex.en: Life with three kids is noisy, but I [[wouldn't have it any other way]].
ex.zh: 家里三个孩子很吵，可我就喜欢这样。

ex.en: The job is hard, but she [[wouldn't have it any other way]].
ex.zh: 工作很辛苦，但她乐在其中。

words.def: used to say that you are happy with a situation as it is, even if it has disadvantages

cloze.before: Newcomers grumble; most Germans would not have it any other
cloze.hint: 就喜欢这样（would not have it any other ___）
cloze.szh: 新来的人抱怨连连；大多数德国人却觉得就该这样。

words.note: 用祈使句代替 if 条件句，后面接 and + 结果：Work hard and you'll pass.（努力，你就会及格。）接 or 表示“否则”：Hurry up, or you'll be late.（快点，不然要迟到了。）
words.ctx: Arrive in a German town on a Sunday and you may think something has gone badly wrong.

ex.en: Turn left [[and you]]'ll see the station.
ex.zh: 向左转，你就会看到车站。

ex.en: Study every day [[and you]] will improve.
ex.zh: 每天学习，你就会进步。

words.conn: 祈使句（动词原形开头）+ and + 结果句；+ or + 否则的结果

pick.q: Leave now, ___ you'll miss the train.
pick.why: “现在走，否则会错过火车”，表示否则用 or。

pick.q: Smile at people, ___ they'll smile back.
pick.why: “对人微笑，他们就会回你微笑”，表示结果用 and。

cloze.after: in a German town on a Sunday and you may think something has gone badly wrong.
cloze.hint: （___ in a German town ... and you ...）
cloze.szh: 星期天到德国的某个小镇，你可能会以为出了什么大事。

words.note: 按部门（department）分区卖各种商品的大商店。
words.ctx: Supermarkets are dark, department stores are locked, and the high street is eerily quiet.

ex.en: She bought the coat in a [[department store]].
ex.zh: 她在百货商店买了这件外套。

ex.en: Many [[department stores]] are closing down.
ex.zh: 很多百货商店正在关门。

words.def: a large shop that sells many different kinds of goods in different sections

cloze.before: Supermarkets are dark,
cloze.after: stores are locked, and the high street is eerily quiet.
cloze.szh: 超市黑着灯，百货商店锁着门，商业街安静得出奇。

words.note: 英国城镇里商店集中的主要街道；美式说 main street。high-street shops：街边连锁店。
words.ctx: Supermarkets are dark, department stores are locked, and the high street is eerily quiet.

ex.en: There's a new café on the [[high street]].
ex.zh: 主街上新开了一家咖啡馆。

ex.en: Online shopping is hurting the [[high street]].
ex.zh: 网购正在冲击实体商业街。

words.def: the main street of a town, where most shops are (British English)

words.ctx: Supermarkets are dark, department stores are locked, and the high street is eerily quiet.

ex.en: The empty school was [[eerily]] quiet.
ex.zh: 空无一人的学校安静得诡异。

ex.en: The two stories are [[eerily]] similar.
ex.zh: 这两个故事相似得出奇。

words.def: in a strange and slightly frightening way

words.note: go on strike（举行罢工），a train strike（火车罢工）。动词 strike 还有“打、击中”的意思。
words.ctx: This is not a strike or a holiday; it is simply the law.

ex.en: The workers went on [[strike]] for higher pay.
ex.zh: 工人们为了提高工资举行罢工。

ex.en: A rail [[strike]] has closed the stations.
ex.zh: 铁路罢工让车站都关了。

words.def: a period when workers refuse to work, in order to get better pay or conditions

cloze.before: This is not a
cloze.after: or a holiday; it is simply the law.
cloze.szh: 这不是罢工，也不是节假日；这只是法律规定。

words.note: restrict sth to ...：把……限制在……。名词 restriction（限制）。
words.ctx: Sunday trading is tightly restricted, and the constitution itself protects the day as one of rest and spiritual uplift.

ex.en: Parking is [[restricted]] to residents.
ex.zh: 停车仅限居民。

ex.en: The new law [[restricts]] the sale of fireworks.
ex.zh: 新法律限制烟花的销售。

words.def: to limit or control the size, amount or range of something

cf.diff: limit 侧重“设定上限、不超过某个数量”；restrict 侧重“约束、不让自由行动”，常用于规定、法律。

ex.en: Please [[limit]] your answer to 100 words.
ex.zh: 回答请限制在 100 字以内。

cloze.before: Sunday trading is tightly
cloze.after: , and the constitution itself protects the day as one of rest and spiritual uplift.
cloze.szh: 星期天营业受到严格限制，而且宪法本身就把这一天定为休息和精神提升的日子。

words.note: a country's constitution（国家的宪法）。形容词 constitutional（宪法的）。也指“体质”：a strong constitution。
words.ctx: Sunday trading is tightly restricted, and the constitution itself protects the day as one of rest and spiritual uplift.

ex.en: Free speech is protected by the [[constitution]].
ex.zh: 言论自由受宪法保护。

ex.en: She has a strong [[constitution]] and rarely gets ill.
ex.zh: 她体质好，很少生病。

words.def: the set of basic laws and principles by which a country is governed

cloze.before: Sunday trading is tightly restricted, and the

words.note: 名词：spiritual uplift（精神提升）。形容词 uplifting（令人振奋的）：an uplifting story。
words.ctx: Sunday trading is tightly restricted, and the constitution itself protects the day as one of rest and spiritual uplift.

ex.en: The music gave everyone a sense of [[uplift]].
ex.zh: 音乐让每个人都很振奋。

ex.en: It's an [[uplifting]] film about friendship.
ex.zh: 这是一部关于友情的振奋人心的电影。

words.def: a feeling of hope and happiness; something that improves your mood

cf.diff: uplift 让人振奋；upset 让人难过、心烦，正好相反。

cloze.before: Sunday trading is tightly restricted, and the constitution itself protects the day as one of rest and spiritual

words.note: with the exception of（除……之外），make an exception（破例）。形容词 exceptional（杰出的）。
words.ctx: A few exceptions keep the country running.

ex.en: Everyone came, with the [[exception]] of Tom.
ex.zh: 除了汤姆，大家都来了。

ex.en: I'll make an [[exception]] this time.
ex.zh: 这次我破个例。

words.def: a person or thing that does not follow a general rule

cloze.before: A few
cloze.after: keep the country running.
cloze.szh: 有几个例外让国家照常运转。

words.note: deprive sb of sth：剥夺某人的……。be deprived of sleep（睡眠不足）。形容词 deprived（贫困的）。
words.ctx: Bakeries may open for a few hours, so that nobody is deprived of fresh rolls, and shops in railway stations do a roaring trade.

ex.en: The prisoners were [[deprived of]] sleep.
ex.zh: 囚犯被剥夺了睡眠。

ex.en: Children should not be [[deprived of]] play.
ex.zh: 不应该剥夺孩子玩耍的权利。

words.def: to take something away from someone, or to stop them from having it

cf.diff: deprive sb of sth 和 rob sb of sth 结构一样（人 + of + 东西）；rob 多指抢劫，也可比喻“夺走”机会、快乐等。

ex.en: The injury [[robbed]] him of his chance to play.
ex.zh: 伤病让他失去了上场的机会。

words.note: 英式说法。roaring 之前学过（喧闹的；兴旺的）。Ice-cream sellers do a roaring trade in summer.
words.ctx: Bakeries may open for a few hours, so that nobody is deprived of fresh rolls, and shops in railway stations do a roaring trade.

ex.en: Umbrella sellers [[did a roaring trade]] in the rain.
ex.zh: 下雨天卖伞的生意火爆。

ex.en: The new bakery is [[doing a roaring trade]].

words.note: knock on the door。knock at the door 也可以。knock on wood：（美式）摸木头祈求好运。
words.ctx: Otherwise, anyone who forgot to buy milk on Saturday must wait, or knock on a neighbour's door.

ex.en: Someone is [[knocking on]] the door.
ex.zh: 有人在敲门。

ex.en: Please [[knock on]] my door if you need anything.
ex.zh: 需要什么就敲我的门。

words.def: to hit a door or window with your hand so that people inside hear you

cloze.before: Otherwise, anyone who forgot to buy milk on Saturday must wait, or
cloze.after: on a neighbour's door.
cloze.szh: 除此之外，谁要是星期六忘了买牛奶，就只能等着，或者去敲邻居的门。

words.note: extend a visit（延长访问），The garden extends to the river.（花园一直延伸到河边。）名词 extension。
words.ctx: The quiet extends well beyond the shops.

ex.en: The deadline has been [[extended]] to Friday.
ex.zh: 截止日期延长到了周五。

ex.en: The forest [[extends]] for miles.
ex.zh: 森林绵延好几英里。

words.def: to make something longer or larger; to reach as far as a particular point

cf.diff: extend 侧重往长度、时间方向“延长、延伸”（extend a visa 延签）；expand 侧重整体“扩大、膨胀”（expand a business）。

ex.en: The company plans to [[expand]] into Asia.
ex.zh: 公司计划扩展到亚洲。

cloze.before: The quiet
cloze.after: well beyond the shops.
cloze.szh: 这份安静远远不止于商店。

words.note: be frowned upon：被认为不妥。Smoking indoors is frowned upon.（在室内吸烟会招人反感。）
words.ctx: In many places it is frowned upon, and sometimes against local rules, to mow the lawn, drill holes in walls or even drop bottles into a recycling bin on a Sunday.

ex.en: Eating on the train is [[frowned upon]] here.
ex.zh: 在这里，坐火车时吃东西会招人白眼。

ex.en: Her parents [[frowned on]] the idea.
ex.zh: 她父母不赞成这个主意。

words.ctx: In many places it is frowned upon, and sometimes against local rules, to mow the lawn, drill holes in walls or even drop bottles into a recycling bin on a Sunday.

ex.zh: 我听见厨房里碗碟碰撞的声音。

ex.zh: 托盘哐啷一声掉在地上。

ex.zh: 他有时会在洗澡时唱歌。

ex.en: Bears [[have been known to]] open car doors.
ex.zh: 熊曾经打开过车门。

ex.en: The washing machine is [[spinning]].
ex.zh: 洗衣机在甩干。

words.note: retail（零售）+ -er。wholesaler：批发商。
words.ctx: Business groups have long argued that the rules cost money and hurt retailers competing with online shops.

ex.en: Big [[retailers]] cut their prices.
ex.zh: 大型零售商降了价。

ex.zh: 这家零售商在欧洲有 300 家店。

words.note: loosen a tie（松开领带），loosen the rules（放宽规定）。反义 tighten（收紧）。
words.ctx: Each attempt to loosen them meets fierce resistance from an unlikely alliance of churches and trade unions.

ex.en: He [[loosened]] his tie after the meeting.
ex.zh: 会后他松了松领带。

ex.zh: 政府打算放宽规定。

words.def: to make something less tight or less strict

ex.en: The government [[tightened]] the rules.
ex.zh: 政府收紧了规定。

ex.en: These trousers are a bit [[loose]].
ex.zh: 这条裤子有点松。

ex.zh: 农民和艺术家结成了意想不到的联盟。

ex.zh: 两家对手公司加入了同一个联盟。

cloze.szh: 每次想放宽这些规定，都会遭到一个意想不到的联盟的强烈反对：教会和工会。

words.note: 英式说法，美式说 labor union。也简称 union。
words.ctx: Each attempt to loosen them meets fierce resistance from an unlikely alliance of churches and trade unions.

ex.en: She joined a [[trade union]] at work.
ex.zh: 她在单位加入了工会。

ex.en: The [[unions]] called for a strike.
ex.zh: 工会号召罢工。

words.def: an organization of workers that tries to improve their pay and conditions (British English)

cloze.before: Each attempt to loosen them meets fierce resistance from an unlikely alliance of churches and trade
cloze.szh: 每次想放宽这些规定，都会遭到一个意想不到的联盟的强烈反对：教会和工会。

words.note: a sacred place（圣地）。比喻：My weekends are sacred.（我的周末神圣不可侵犯。）
words.ctx: Churches defend Sunday as sacred; unions defend it as the one day shop workers can count on spending with their families.

ex.en: The river is [[sacred]] to local people.
ex.zh: 这条河在当地人心中是神圣的。

ex.en: My morning coffee is [[sacred]].
ex.zh: 我早上的咖啡雷打不动。

words.def: very important and treated with great respect, often for religious reasons

cf.diff: holy 多与宗教直接相关（holy water）；sacred 也可用于宗教，还可比喻“不可侵犯、极其重要”的东西。

cloze.before: Churches defend Sunday as
cloze.after: ; unions defend it as the one day shop workers can count on spending with their families.
cloze.szh: 教会捍卫星期天，是因为它神圣；工会捍卫它，是因为这是店员们唯一确定能和家人一起过的日子。

words.note: side with sb against sb：站在某人一边反对另一人。
words.ctx: Courts have mostly sided with them.

ex.en: My mum always [[sides with]] my sister.
ex.zh: 我妈总是站在我姐姐那边。

ex.en: The judge [[sided with]] the workers.
ex.zh: 法官支持了工人。

words.def: to support one person or group in an argument

cloze.before: Courts have mostly
cloze.after: with them.
cloze.szh: 法院大多站在他们一边。

words.note: to one's surprise（令某人吃惊的是），rather 让语气更委婉、更英式。
words.ctx: Many foreigners find the arrangement maddening at first and then, rather to their surprise, come to love it.

ex.en: [[To my surprise]], she said yes.
ex.zh: 让我吃惊的是，她答应了。

ex.en: [[To our surprise]], the shop was open.
ex.zh: 出乎我们意料，那家店居然开着。

words.def: used to say that something surprised you a little

cloze.before: Many foreigners find the arrangement maddening at first and then, rather to their
cloze.after: , come to love it.
cloze.szh: 很多外国人起初觉得这种安排让人抓狂，后来却出乎自己意料地爱上了它。

words.note: 表示态度慢慢转变：come to like / understand / realise。I came to love the city.（我渐渐爱上了这座城市。）
words.ctx: Many foreigners find the arrangement maddening at first and then, rather to their surprise, come to love it.

ex.en: I [[came to]] enjoy living alone.
ex.zh: 我渐渐喜欢上了一个人住。

ex.en: She [[came to]] realise he was right.
ex.zh: 她终于意识到他是对的。

words.def: to gradually start to feel or think something

cf.diff: become 是状态的改变（become angry）；come to + 动词（如 love、realise）强调感情或认识“慢慢地、渐渐地”形成。

ex.en: I [[came to]] realise she was right.
ex.zh: 我渐渐意识到她是对的。

cloze.before: Many foreigners find the arrangement maddening at first and then, rather to their surprise,
cloze.after: to love it.
cloze.szh: 很多外国人起初觉得这种安排让人抓狂，后来却出乎自己意料地爱上了它。

words.note: close relatives（近亲），visit relatives（走亲戚）。形容词 relative 是“相对的”。
words.ctx: With nothing to buy and nowhere to queue, people walk, cycle, visit relatives or linger over long lunches.

ex.en: We're visiting [[relatives]] this weekend.
ex.zh: 这个周末我们去走亲戚。

ex.en: She's a distant [[relative]] of mine.
ex.zh: 她是我的一个远房亲戚。

words.def: a member of your family

cf.diff: relative 和 relation 都可以指“亲戚”；但 relation 主要意思是“关系”，所以说“亲戚”时 relative 更清楚。

cloze.before: With nothing to buy and nowhere to queue, people walk, cycle, visit
cloze.after: or linger over long lunches.
cloze.szh: 没东西可买，也没地方排队，人们就散步、骑车、走亲戚，或者慢悠悠地吃顿长长的午饭。

words.note: linger：逗留、不愿离开。linger over a meal / coffee：慢慢吃饭 / 喝咖啡。
words.ctx: With nothing to buy and nowhere to queue, people walk, cycle, visit relatives or linger over long lunches.

ex.en: We [[lingered over]] coffee for an hour.
ex.zh: 我们慢悠悠地喝了一个小时咖啡。

ex.en: Don't [[linger over]] every question in the exam.
ex.zh: 考试时别在每道题上磨蹭。

words.def: to spend a long time doing something because you are enjoying it

cf.diff: linger 单用还可以指气味、感觉“久久不散”。

ex.en: The smell [[lingered]] for days.
ex.zh: 那股味道好几天都没散。

cloze.before: With nothing to buy and nowhere to queue, people walk, cycle, visit relatives or
cloze.after: over long lunches.
cloze.szh: 没东西可买，也没地方排队，人们就散步、骑车、走亲戚，或者慢悠悠地吃顿长长的午饭。

words.note: go + 形容词表示变化：go quiet / go red（脸红）/ go bad（变质）。
words.ctx: Parks fill up; phones go quiet.

ex.en: The room [[went quiet]] when she walked in.
ex.zh: 她一进来，屋里就安静了。

ex.en: My phone [[goes quiet]] after ten at night.
ex.zh: 晚上十点以后我的手机就静音了。

words.def: to become silent or less active

cloze.before: Parks fill up; phones go
cloze.szh: 公园里人满为患；手机都安静下来。

words.note: a reminder of / that ...。set a reminder（设个提醒）。动词 remind。
words.ctx: It is a weekly reminder that not every hour needs to be productive.

ex.en: I set a [[reminder]] on my phone.
ex.zh: 我在手机上设了个提醒。

ex.en: The photo is a [[reminder]] of happy days.
ex.zh: 这张照片让人想起快乐的日子。

words.def: something that makes you remember or think about something

cloze.before: It is a weekly
cloze.after: that not every hour needs to be productive.
cloze.szh: 这每周都在提醒人们：不是每个小时都必须有成效。

words.note: a productive day / meeting（有成效的一天 / 会议）。名词 productivity（生产力）。
words.ctx: It is a weekly reminder that not every hour needs to be productive.

ex.en: It was a very [[productive]] meeting.
ex.zh: 这是一次很有成效的会议。

ex.en: I feel more [[productive]] in the morning.
ex.zh: 我早上效率更高。

words.def: achieving a lot; producing a large amount of something

cf.diff: productive 有成效；unproductive 白忙一场、没成果。

cloze.before: It is a weekly reminder that not every hour needs to be
cloze.szh: 这每周都在提醒人们：不是每个小时都必须有成效。

words.note: 名词 punctuality（守时）。be punctual for sth（准时出席）。
words.ctx: And on Monday morning, the shops open again, as punctual as ever.

ex.en: German trains are not always [[punctual]].
ex.zh: 德国的火车也不总是准时。

ex.en: She is always [[punctual]] for meetings.
ex.zh: 她开会总是很准时。

words.def: arriving or doing something at exactly the right time

cf.diff: on time 是短语，用在句子后面（arrive on time）；punctual 是形容词，形容人“守时”的品质（She is always punctual.）。

ex.en: The train arrived [[on time]].
ex.zh: 火车准时到达。

cloze.before: And on Monday morning, the shops open again, as
cloze.after: as ever.
cloze.szh: 到了星期一早上，商店又照常开门，一如既往地准时。

words.note: She looked as beautiful as ever.（她还是那么漂亮。）也单独用：As ever, he was late.（他一如既往地迟到了。）
words.ctx: And on Monday morning, the shops open again, as punctual as ever.

ex.en: [[As ever]], the train was late.
ex.zh: 火车一如既往地晚点了。

ex.en: She's as busy [[as ever]].
ex.zh: 她还是那么忙。

words.def: used to say that something is still the same as it has always been

cloze.before: And on Monday morning, the shops open again, as punctual as
cloze.szh: 到了星期一早上，商店又照常开门，一如既往地准时。
